content: The internship includes 13 key milestones: Onboarding, Alchemy (bonding), Lunch Ninja (meeting leaders), Intervention (mid-review), Demo Day (final showcase), and the Intern EXPO.
Adobe ACS values being Genuine, Raising the Bar, Owning Your Outcome, and Creating Your Future. The culture is first-name basis (no Sir/Ma'am).
Office is located at PTP 4, Bangalore. Dress code is casual. The Hub is the go-to for IT issues. Flexible work hours are standard, but core team hours should be respected.
Interns should link their personal GitHub to their Adobe identity. Common tools include Outlook, Teams, Slack, and internal wikis for documentation.
In case of university exams, interns can take leave by informing their mentors in advance. The stipend is paid monthly, usually around the 30th.
